title: Projekt & Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Projekte koordinieren, sondern die operativen Abläufe eines innovativen Technologieunternehmens ganzheitlich mitgestalten? Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick, erkennst Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungen? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. Unser Kunde entwickelt und fertigt autonome Drohnensysteme, Einsatzsoftware und spezialisierte Lösungen für Industrie, Netzbetreiber, Behörden und maritime Anwendungen. Dabei entstehen hochspezialisierte Systeme, die Hardware, Software und autonome Technologien miteinander verbinden und bereits bei namhaften Kunden zum Einsatz kommen. Für die weitere Entwicklung des Unternehmens wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die das operative Tagesgeschäft übernimmt, Projekte und Ressourcen koordiniert und gemeinsam mit dem Geschäftsführer Strukturen für weiteres Wachstum schafft. Deine Benefits Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht. Gestaltungsspielraum: Übernimm eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der operativen Strukturen und Prozesse. Verantwortung: Direkte Verantwortung für die operative Organisation und die Koordination zahlreicher Unternehmensbereiche mit 15 Mitarbeitern. Entwicklungsperspektive: Die Position bietet langfristig die Möglichkeit, sich zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Bereich Operations weiterzuentwickeln. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Entscheidungswege und enger Austausch mit dem Geschäftsführer. Technologieumfeld: Arbeite an innovativen Drohnensystemen und autonomen Technologien mit anspruchsvollen Anwendungen. Unternehmenskultur: Flache Strukturen, offene Kommunikation und ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Technikaffinität. Mobiles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist nach Absprache möglich, sofern es die jeweiligen Aufgaben und die operative Situation erlauben. Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Ausstattung mit aktueller Hard und Software sowie kurze Wege zwischen Entwicklung, Produktion und Projektmanagement. Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander. Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet. Deine Aufgaben Als Projekt & Operations Managerübernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte, Ressourcen und interne Abläufe zuverlässig ineinandergreifen. Operative Steuerung: Koordination des täglichen Geschäftsbetriebs über die Bereiche Werkstatt, Produktion, Entwicklung, Projektkoordination, Beschaffung und Flugbetrieb hinweg. Projektkoordination: Steuerung mehrerer paralleler Entwicklungs-, Liefer- und Forschungsprojekte hinsichtlich Terminen, Ressourcen, Qualität und Budgets. Priorisierung: Wöchentliche Abstimmung der Projektprioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourcen sowie eigenständige Lösung entstehender Konflikte. Produktion: Koordination von Produktion, Ausgangsprüfung und Auslieferung der Drohnensysteme. Prozesse: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter operativer Abläufe in Bereichen wie Projektplanung, Aufgabensteuerung, Einkauf, Lager und Qualitätsmanagement. Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen aus Entwicklung, Produktion, Projektmanagement und weiteren internen Bereichen. Projektmanagement: Unterstützung und Koordination bei Kundenprojekten, Lieferungen, Abnahmen und weiteren operativen Vorhaben. Compliance: Koordination relevanter Themen rund um Exportkontrolle, Zoll und erforderliche Dokumentationen. Geschäftsführung: Entlastung des Geschäftsführers im operativen Tagesgeschäft, damit dieser sich stärker auf Strategie, Technologie und Schlüsselkunden konzentrieren kann. Weiterentwicklung: Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Vorantreiben von Maßnahmen zur Skalierung und Automatisierung der operativen Abläufe. Dein Profil als Projekt & Operations Manager Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Operations Management oder in einer vergleichbaren verantwortungsvollen Position mit technischen Produkten. Ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten, die Entwicklung und Fertigung verbinden, idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit eigener Produktion. Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Rolle mit Führungsbezug oder der Steuerung von Teams und Projekten. Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer paralleler Projekte sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Termine, Ressourcen, Budgets und Prioritäten. Technisches Verständnis für mechatronische Systeme und die Fähigkeit, sich auf Augenhöhe mit Konstruktion, Elektronik und Software auszutauschen. Eine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen ohne lange Abstimmungswege voranzutreiben. Eine ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und die Bereitschaft, in einem kleinen Unternehmen ohne große Stabstrukturen selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort sowie gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kunden, Testkampagnen, Übungen und Messen. Diese Einsätze halten sich in der Regel in Grenzen und finden maximal etwa einmal pro Monat statt. Nice to have Erfahrung im Verteidigungs-, Marine-, Luftfahrt- oder Behördenumfeld. Kenntnisse im Bereich Drohnen oder unbemannte Systeme. Erfahrung mit Exportkontrolle, BAFA oder Zoll. Erfahrung mit Kleinserienfertigung. Kenntnisse in Jira oder vergleichbaren Projektmanagementsystemen. Kaufmännisches Verständnis für Kalkulation, Projektcontrolling oder Liquiditätsplanung. Erfahrung beim Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem Wachstumsunternehmen oder Start-Up. Projektmanagement Zertifizierung wie PMP, IPMA oder PRINCE2. Deine Perspektive als Projekt & Operations Manager Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, sich langfristig zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen, hast einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und kannst die operativen Strukturen maßgeblich mitgestalten. Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Wenn du technische Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern die operativen Abläufe eines innovativen Technologieunternehmens aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf. In einem kurzen, unverbindlichen Telefonat geben wir dir anschließend alle weiteren Informationen zur Position und zum Unternehmen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Über uns: Wer ist Modumat und was treibt uns an? Wir sind Modumat – und wir gestalten die Zukunft der smarten, nachhaltigen Warenausgabe! Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengestützt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag – von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels. Hinter Modumat stehen wir: Raphael und Frederik , zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp läuft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde jüngst mit der Dörte-Wörner-Innovationsförderung ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Frühjahr unseren Master abschließen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das EXIST-Gründerstipendium , um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen. Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied – die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive für unser Gründungsteam! Was du bei Modumat bewegst Als kaufmännische und kommunikative Säule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und Märkten, die sie brauchen: Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation: Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere Lösung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (über LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen). Fokus Hospitality & Gästeerlebnis: Du tauchst tief in die Welt der Hotellerie ein (z. B. moderne 24/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger*innen der Branche Lösungen, die Gäste und Hotelteams gleichermaßen begeistern. Partnerschaften & Kundenbeziehungen: Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu B2B-Partnern auf (Hotels, Coworking-Spaces, moderne Gastgeber) und gewinnst gemeinsam mit uns erste Pilotpartner sowie Letters of Intent (LOIs) für den EXIST-Antrag. Geschäftsmodell & EXIST-Antrag: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Teil unserer Gründungsreise – von der Markt- und Zielgruppenanalyse über faire Pricing-Modelle bis hin zur Finanzplanung im Rahmen des EXIST-Stipendiums. Webpräsenz & Außenwirkung: Du gestaltest unseren Auftritt (Website, Pitch Decks, Kommunikationsmaterial) so, dass aus innovativer Technik verständliche, einladende Mehrwerte für unsere Kund*innen werden. Was du mitbringst (Hinweis: Du musst noch nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt jahrelange Erfahrung haben – viel wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen!) Studienhintergrund: Du studierst BWL, Marketing, Hospitality-/Tourismus-Management, International Business, Kommunikationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach (kurz vor dem Masterabschluss oder bereits abgeschlossen). Gespür für Hospitality & Service (großes Plus): Du kennst die Dynamik der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie (z. B. Personalmangel, Gästebedürfnisse, 24/7-Service) aus Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder deinem Netzwerk – oder du hast große Lust, diese spannende Branche mit sinnstiftender Technologie zu unterstützen. Kommunikationsstärke & Kundenfokus: Du hörst Kund*innen genau zu, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und kannst komplexe Produkte empathisch, klar und überzeugend vermitteln. Offenheit für Tech & moderne KI-Tools: Du musst keine Zeile Code schreiben. Wichtig ist, dass du neugierig auf digitale Innovationen bist und moderne KI-Tools (wie ChatGPT, Canva/Design-Tools oder Recherche-Tools) gerne nutzt, um dir den Arbeitsalltag kreativ und effizient zu erleichtern. Gestaltungswille & Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, schätzt aber genauso den engen Austausch im Team, um gemeinsam Ideen weiterzuentwickeln. Was dich bei uns erwartet Gründen auf echter Augenhöhe: Du kommst nicht als Angestellte*r dazu, sondern als vollwertige Co-Founderin bzw. vollwertiger Co-Founder. Wir treffen Entscheidungen gemeinsam und legen großen Wert auf eine offene, wertschätzende und transparente Teamkultur. Finanzielle Sicherheit & faire Anteile: Über das EXIST-Gründerstipendium erhältst du nach Bewilligung bis zu 2.500 €/Monat , um dich ohne finanziellen Druck auf das Startup zu konzentrieren. Zudem erhältst du eine faire, transparente Beteiligung (Equity) an der gemeinsamen GmbH. Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance: Ob in unserem schönen, ausgestatteten Projektraum an der h_da (Gebäude D22) oder flexibel im Homeoffice – wir richten unsere Arbeitsweise so ein, dass sie zu unserem Leben passt. Ein verlässliches Fundament: Du startest nicht bei null. Technik, Prototyp und erste Förderungen sind bereits da – und wir (Raphael & Frederik) stehen dir als verlässliche, hilfsbereite Partner bei allen technischen Fragen jederzeit den Rücken frei. Starkes Netzwerk & Mentoring: Rundum-Support durch YUBIZZ!, das Startup-Zentrum der Hochschule Darmstadt (Workshops, Gründungsförderung & Ökosystem), sowie individuelles Mentoring und Sparring durch unseren Gründercoach Prof. Dr. Michael von Rüden. Hast du Lust, Modumat gemeinsam mit uns groß zu machen? Wenn du dich in vielen Punkten wiederfindest – auch wenn vielleicht nicht jeder einzelne Haken zu 100 % sitzt –, freuen wir uns riesig, von dir zu hören! Schreib uns einfach eine kurze, unkomplizierte Nachricht mit deinem LinkedIn-Profil oder Lebenslauf. Lass uns gerne ganz entspannt bei einem Kaffee oder Tee an der Hochschule Darmstadt oder via Video-Call kennenlernen und schauen, ob die Chemie stimmt! description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h2><strong>Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend&nbsp;</strong></h2> <h4><strong>The Opportunity:&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.<br><br>You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.</p> <p>AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be accountable for the performance of <strong>two</strong> distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.</li> <li>Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.</li> <li>Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.</li> <li>Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.</li> <li>Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.</li> <li>Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.</li> <li>Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.</li> <li>Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.</li> <li>Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.</li> <li>Lead improvements across Grafana and R&amp;D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.</li> <li>Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.</li> <li>A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.</li> <li>Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.</li> <li>An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.</li> <li>Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.</li> <li>Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.</li> <li>Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR <span data-sheets-root="1">124,571</span><span data-sheets-root="1">&nbsp;</span>- EUR <span data-sheets-root="1">149,485</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.&nbsp;</p> <p>All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.</p></div><p><strong>DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS</strong></p> <p>As the Director – European Government Operations, based in <strong>Munich/ Berlin, </strong>Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead Rocket Lab’s in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market</li> <li>Develop and lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives</li> <li>Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies</li> <li>Establish and grow Rocket Lab’s presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs</li> <li>Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market Europe</li> <li>Professional fluency in German and English</li> <li>Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions</li> <li>Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring</li> <li>Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes</li> <li>Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment</li> <li>Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors</li> <li>Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies</li> <li>Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting</li> <li>Experience working in Munich’s government, defense, or technology ecosystem</li> <li>Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks</li> </ul> <p><em><u>This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas</u></em>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">WHAT TO EXPECT</span></strong><span <p><span data-contrast="auto">We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.</em></p> <p><em>Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at <a ---------- dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.</em></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:</strong></span></p> <p><em>For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.&nbsp; These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.&nbsp; For more information on these Regulations, click here <a class="fui-Link ___m14voj0 f3rmtva f1ern45e f1deefiw f1n71otn f1q5o8ev f1h8hb77 f1vxd6vx f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1hu3pq6 f11qmguv f19f4twv f1tyq0we f1g0x7ka fhxju0i f1qch9an f1cnd47f fqv5qza f1vmzxwi f1o700av f13mvf36 f9n3di6 f1ids18y fygtlnl f1deo86v f12x56k7 f1iescvh ftqa4ok f50u1b5 fs3pq8b f1hghxdh f1tymzes f1x7u7e9 f1cmlufx f10aw75t fsle3fq" href="https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2020/01/23/2020-00574/international-traffic-in-arms-regulations-us-munitions-list-categories-i-ii-and-iii" target="_blank">ITAR Regulations.</a></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p></p> <p>About us</p> <p>EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. reporting, and keep them up to date</p> <p>● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment</p> <p>What you bring</p> <p>Must have</p> <p>● 4+ years of professional experience in finance &amp; accounting</p> <p>● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language</p> <p>● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment</p> <p>● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo</p> <p>● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance</p> <p>● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information</p> <p>Nice to have</p> <p>● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling</p> <p>● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors — ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment</p> <p>● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins</p> <p>● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality — you want to shape things, not just administer them</p> <p>Why EggAI?</p> <p>● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team</p> <p>● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders — short paths, fast decisions</p> <p>● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up</p> <p>● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe</p> <p>Sounds like you?</p> <p>We'd love to hear from you!<br><br>If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.</p> <p>Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About EggAI</h1> <p class="code-line" data-line="8"><strong>Agentic workforces are inevitable. description: <p><strong>EggAI Labs</strong> · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="4"><em>Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.</em></p> <h2 id="eggai-labs" class="code-line" data-line="6">EggAI Labs</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="8">We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="10">As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.</p> <h2 id="the-problem-evalops" class="code-line" data-line="12">The problem: EvalOps</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="13"><strong>How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?</strong></p> <p class="code-line" data-line="15">We will explore&nbsp;<strong>EvalOps</strong>: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.</p> <p class="code-line" data-line="17">These questions will guide the initial work:</p> <ul class="code-line" data-line="18"> <li class="code-line" data-line="18"><strong>Regression suites</strong>: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="19"><strong>Coverage estimation</strong>: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="20"><strong>Live monitoring</strong>: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="21"><strong>Eval analysis</strong>: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.</li> </ul> <h2 id="the-role" class="code-line" data-line="24">The role</h2> <p class="code-line" data-line="26">As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:</p> <ul class="code-line" data-line="27"> <li class="code-line" data-line="27">Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="28">Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="29">Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="30">Communicate decisions and learning clearly.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="31">Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="32">Code and build end to end.</li> </ul> <p class="code-line" data-line="34">This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.</p> <h2 id="three-pillars-different-passions" class="code-line" data-line="36">Three pillars, different passions</h2> <table class="code-line" data-line="38"> <thead class="code-line" data-line="38"> <tr class="code-line" data-line="38"> <th style="text-align: left;">Pillar</th> <th style="text-align: left;">Driving question</th> <th style="text-align: left;">Possible EvalOps focus</th> </tr> </thead> <tbody class="code-line" data-line="40"> <tr class="code-line" data-line="40"> <td><strong>Product</strong></td> <td>What should we build?</td> <td>Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.</td> </tr> <tr class="code-line" data-line="41"> <td><strong>Engineering</strong></td> <td>How should we build it?</td> <td>Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.</td> </tr> <tr class="code-line" data-line="42"> <td><strong>Data Science</strong></td> <td>How do we know it works?</td> <td>Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.</td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <p class="code-line" data-line="45">We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.</p> <h2 id="what-we-value" class="code-line" data-line="45">What we value</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="46"> <li class="code-line" data-line="46"><strong>Problem obsession</strong>. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="47"><strong>Initiative and follow-through</strong>. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="48"><strong>Evidence of making things work</strong>. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="49"><strong>Independent judgment</strong>. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="50"><strong>Generosity in collaboration</strong>. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2 id="what-is-required" class="code-line" data-line="53">What is required</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="54"> <li class="code-line" data-line="54">You are pursuing a Master’s degree.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="55">You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.</li> <li class="code-line" data-line="56">You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.</li> </ul> <p class="code-line" data-line="58">Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.</p> <h2 id="what-you-will-gain" class="code-line" data-line="60">What you will gain</h2> <ul class="code-line" data-line="61"> <li class="code-line" data-line="61"><strong>Industry insight</strong>. title: Senior Finance Manager, Germany (m/w/d)
description: <p></p> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Location:</strong> Hamburg, Germany<br><strong>Working pattern:</strong> Full-time, on-site<br><strong>Focus:</strong> German BESS portfolio, across construction, operations, transactions and financial reporting</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>About BW ESS</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain and Sweden, with more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems, approximately 12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>To find out more, visit: <a href="https://bw-ess.com/">https://bw-ess.com/</a></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>How We Work</strong></div> <div>Our culture rests on a few clear foundations: talent density over team size, flexible people over fixed structures, context over control, results over processes, and transparent, clear feedback. We move fast, give people real ownership early, and expect strong judgement and accountability in return.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>The Role</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is seeking a Senior Finance Manager, Germany to take finance ownership of its German BESS portfolio across construction, operations, transactions and financial reporting.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>This is a broad, hands-on role combining strong financial control with commercial finance, portfolio management and transaction support. You will act as the principal finance partner to the German business, working closely with Development, Construction, Asset Management, Strategic Finance, Treasury and Tax, as well as JV partners, lenders and external advisers.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></div> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Construction finance.</strong> Take finance ownership of projects through the construction phase, including oversight of project budgets, expenditure, cash requirements and capital drawdowns. You will ensure project costs are properly tracked, allocated and reported, with clear visibility of performance against budget and investment case.</li> <li><strong>Investment and project support.</strong> Support project teams and Strategic Finance with FID materials, financial analysis and other investment decision-making. You will also help track construction-stage VAT, supplier payment terms, capex classification and cash-flow timing for German SPVs.</li> <li><strong>German portfolio operations.</strong> Take finance ownership of the operating German portfolio, including portfolio management, FP&amp;A and management reporting. You will monitor financial and operational performance against budgets, forecasts and investment cases, providing clear analysis to management and JV partners.</li> <li><strong>Lender and stakeholder reporting.</strong> Manage lender and stakeholder reporting, including covenant monitoring, debt-service metrics, distributions and other project-finance requirements.</li> <li><strong>Transactions.</strong> Support project financings, refinancings, equity transactions and other strategic transactions across the German portfolio. This includes financial analysis, modelling, due diligence and transaction support, working with Strategic Finance, Treasury and external advisers.</li> <li><strong>Financial reporting and control.</strong> Take responsibility for the integrity and accuracy of financial reporting across the German portfolio, including German GAAP/HGB, German tax compliance, local statutory accounts, audits and VAT. You will oversee outsourced accounting providers and ensure high-quality monthly, quarterly and annual reporting, statutory accounts, audit and tax compliance.</li> <li><strong>Governance and systems.</strong> Maintain appropriate financial controls, governance and reporting processes across German SPVs and joint ventures, while supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of finance systems, processes and reporting infrastructure.</li> </ul> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>10 years’ relevant finance experience, ideally in energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities, oil and gas or another asset-intensive environment</div> </li> <li> <div>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related discipline</div> </li> <li> <div>Professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or a German equivalent is preferred; substantial relevant experience may be considered in place of a formal qualification</div> </li> <li> <div>Demonstrable experience across both statutory accounting and FP&amp;A, including close, audit, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience supporting project or portfolio economics, investment appraisal, valuations, cash-flow forecasting or financial modelling</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong knowledge of German statutory reporting, tax and regulatory requirements</div> </li> <li> <div>Confidence operating across SPVs, GmbH structures, complex corporate and JV structures, and project-finance entities</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience managing outsourced service providers</div> </li> <li> <div>Advanced Excel and financial-modelling skills</div> </li> <li> <div>Familiarity with ERP systems, preferably including system migration or integration experience</div> </li> <li> <div>Professional fluency in German and English</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>Nice to have:</strong> Exposure to project finance, debt covenants, lender reporting, M&amp;A due diligence or transaction support. Experience with data automation, BI tools, scripting or AI-enabled analytical tools is also advantageous.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Why Join</strong></div> <div>This is a high-impact finance leadership role at the centre of BW ESS’s German growth. You will work across construction, operations, transactions and reporting, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders, JV partners, lenders and external advisers.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>You’ll help build the finance platform behind major energy storage assets and play a key role in supporting BW ESS’s long-term growth in Germany.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is committed to building a high-performing, inclusive team and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Your personal information will be processed in accordance with our <a href="https://bw-ess.com/bw-ess-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Notice</a>.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Your tasks

Data Analysis & Cost Investigation

Reporting, Visualisation & KPIs 

  • Design dashboards and reports for technical and executive audiences 

  • Define FinOps KPIs and integrate them into live reporting systems aligned with business goals 

Automation & Scaling 

  • Automate reporting, alerting, and data pipelines (PowerAutomate, Python, SQL) 

  • Streamline workflows and scale analytics capabilities across clients 

Cost Allocation & Transparency 

  • Drive tagging strategies, taxonomy design, and showback/chargeback models 

  • Combine technical and business metrics for full-picture cost transparency 

Thought Leadership 

  • Develop FinOps blueprints and playbooks 

  • Contribute trainings, talks, and publications 

  • Expand offerings into FinOps for AI, FinOps for SaaS, or sustainability tracking 

Client Advisory & Consulting 

  • Engage directly with client stakeholders to understand business context, translate analytical findings into strategic recommendations, and present results in workshops and steering committees 

  • Support proposal development, scoping of new engagements, and client relationship management as a trusted advisor on data-driven cost decisions 

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation 

  • Professional development through challenging projects and training opportunities 

  • A diverse, international team with a strong knowledge-sharing culture 

  • Opportunities for thought leadership: conferences, publications, certifications 

  • A collaborative, supportive team environment 


  • Degree in Data Analytics, Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, IT Management, or related field 

  • Proficiency in English and German (min. B2 each) 

  • Residence in Germany with work eligibility 

  • Willingness to travel occasionally 

  • Strong analytical skills with focus on financial data interpretation 

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 

  • Understanding of agile frameworks and consulting/project management experience 

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Experience with SQL, Python, or R for data analysis and automation 

  • Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Apptio BI / TBM Studio, or Tableau) 

  • Excel & PowerQuery proficiency 

  • Understanding of cloud billing data structures (AWS CUR, Azure Cost Export, GCP BigQuery billing) 

  • Proactive, self-organised mindset 

Nice to Have 

  • Cloud certifications or FinOps Practitioner certification 

  • Familiarity with cloud cost management tools (e.g. Cloudability, Flexera, Kubecost, Infracost) 

  • Exposure to ML frameworks or cloud-native forecasting tools 

  • Experience with SaaS management, on-prem licence optimisation, or AI cost management

title: Werkstudent:in - Social Media / Content Creation
description: Hey! Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun, sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Um unserer Community noch näher zu kommen, brauchen wir Dich! Deine Mission: Als Werkstudent:in im Social Media Bereich schaffst du echten Content-Impact für die Marke vly. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Social Media Manager:in sowie dem E-Commerce & Marketing Team unterstützt du dabei sowohl im organischen Bereich als auch für unsere Performance Ads. Dein Profil: Hands-on Content Creation: Du entwickelst zusammen mit dem Social Media Team kreative Ideen, stehst vor der Kamera und nimmst eigenen Content auf (Fokus auf IG Reels & TikTok). Editing & Post-Production: Du schneidest deine gedrehten Videos eigenständig mit CapCut. Format- & Grafik-Erstellung: Du erstellst ergänzende visuelle Assets mit Canva und nutzt moderne KI-Tools, um deinen Workflow zu beschleunigen. Trend-Scouting & Testing: Social Media ist deine Leidenschaft. Du verfolgst aktuelle Trends täglich und identifizierst aktiv virale Formate für unsere Social Media Präsenz und hast Spaß dabei, diese vor der Kamera direkt umzusetzen. Content-Skalierung & Assets: In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Performance Team drehst und schneidest du Performance Ads und kreierst neue Hooks für unsere Zielgruppen. Deine Benefits: Werde Teil unserer Mission: Sei dabei, den Wandel von tierischen zu pflanzlichen Proteinen voranzutreiben! Eine faszinierende Branche - Milchprodukte sind in fast jedem Haushalt zu finden, Haferm*lch und Blutzucker ist in den sozialen Netzwerken allgegenwärtig und die Bedeutung von Gesundheit nimmt ständig zu. Echtes Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events. Teamlunch : Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserem eigener vly-Köchin! Mobilität und Company Fitness:  Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket als auch zu deiner USC-Mitgliedschaft. FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten. vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst! Berufserfahrung: Du hast erste, nachweisbare Erfahrung damit gesammelt, Social Media Content zu erstellen und hast einen eigenen Account. Ausbildung: Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, Design, Kommunikations- & Medienwissenschaften oder äquivalenten Bereichen und bist noch für mindestens 1 Jahr eingeschrieben. Shooting & Cutting Skills: Du weißt, wie man ein Smartphone für gute Aufnahmen nutzt (Licht, Framing) und beherrschst das schnelle Schneiden von Kurzvideos (z. B. CapCut). Kamera-Präsenz & Personality: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, agierst natürlich und nahbar und hast Freude daran, unsere Marke mit deiner begeisternden Art persönlich zu verkörpern. Gespür Social Media & Ästhetik: Du hast eine große Leidenschaft für Social Media (speziell für Instagram & TikTok), ein Gespür für digitale Trends sowie ein Auge für Ästhetik und Bildgestaltung. Cultural Fit: Du brennst für eine gesundheitsorientierte Lebensmittelindustrie, fühlst dich in einer ambitionierten Scale-up-Kultur wohl, und lebst offene und proaktive Kommunikation. Sprache: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Level. Verfügbarkeit: Du bist für 15-20 Stunden/Woche verfügbar. Rahmenbedingungen: Deine Homebase ist Berlin oder die nähere Umgebung. Für den engen Austausch, gemeinsame Sparrings und die Team-Dynamik bist du mindestens 50 % deiner Arbeitszeit pro Woche bei uns im Office – die restliche Zeit arbeitest du flexibel. Wenn du bis hierhin gelesen hast, sollten wir uns definitiv kennenlernen! Sende uns einfach deine Unterlagen - wir freuen uns schon sehr darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: Flight Software Architect
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: What we would love to see from you Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders. In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following: 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems. Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems , ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications. Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software , operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems. Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies. A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment. Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints. The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions. Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures. Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams. A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space. Why you should join us! raw.title: Flight Software Architect
raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

What we would love to see from you

  1. Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.

  2. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities.

  3. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges.

  4. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners.

  5. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches.

  6. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle.

  7. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders.

In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems.

  • Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems, ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications.

  • Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software, operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems.

  • Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies.

  • A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment.

  • Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints.

  • The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions.

  • Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures.

  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams.

  • A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space.

raw.title: Remote Manager (Director) Partnerships DACH (m/f/d)
raw.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

The Role

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types

  • Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

  • Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

  • Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job. You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter. In this role Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision. Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop. Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team. Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve. Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor. Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding. Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments. The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week. What you will need 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently. Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made. Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly. Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it. Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow. A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback. Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on. Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems. Fluency in English is a must. What we offer Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe. Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact. Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure. Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits. Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe. We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform. Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe. We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!
