  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

  • Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

  • Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users.   • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

  • A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security

 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

 

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Questions about the role or our hiring process? Email our Talent team at talent[at]playtestcloud.com.

title: (Senior) SAP IS-U / SAP S/4HANA Utilities Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Fühlst du dich in der Energiewirtschaft zu Hause und willst weiter an ihrer Digitalisierung arbeiten? Du hast in den letzten Jahren bereits viel Erfahrung als Berater gesammelt, hast aber jetzt Lust auf neue Projekte und Kunden ? Dann passt du perfekt in unser Team!  Die Umsetzung verschiedenster Themen in der Energiewirtschaft gehört seit der Gründung von Natuvion zu unseren wesentlichen Kernkompetenzen . Unser Team verfügt über jahrelange Erfahrung in den Kernprozessen der Energiewirtschaft und kombiniert komplexes Prozesswissen mit tiefgreifendem technologischem Verständnis. Als Special Expertise Partner von SAP kennen wir uns bestens mit der neuesten Softwaregeneration SAP S/4HANA Utilities aus. Und bei zahlreichen Energieversorgern gehören Natuvion Add-ons zum bewährten Standard der SAP for Utilities Lösung (IS-U), die die Flexibilität und Leistungsfähigkeit in vielen Bereichen erhöhen - von Lastgangverwaltung bis zur Abrechnung des Messstellenbetriebs. Als (Senior) SAP IS-U / SAP S/4HANA Utilities Consultant (m/w/d) bist du für unsere Kunden ein zuverlässiger Berater in allen Fragen rund um SAP IS-U und SAP S/4HANA Utilities und arbeitest mit uns an verschiedenen Projekten, sei es die Optimierung laufender Systeme oder spannende Transformationsprojekte - und das alles, ohne auf den Komfort deines Homeoffice verzichten zu müssen. Deine Aufgaben: Du bist Ansprechpartner und Berater für unsere deutschen und europäischen Kunden im Energiesektor bei allen Fragen rund um SAP Utilities und übernimmst als Teil- oder Gesamtprojektleiter die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung ihrer Anforderungen. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Standardisierung, Analyse und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Prozesse sowie bei Umzug vom SAP IS-U-System auf die S/4HANA Utilities -Plattform. Dabei wirst du Anforderungskonzepte erstellen, Lösungen entwerfen, deren Umsetzung leiten und Kundenworkshops/Schulungen organisieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Fachthemen und betreust deine Kollegen als Mentor . Dein Profil: Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung in einem kaufmännischen oder technischen Umfeld erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Durch deine Tätigkeit im Energiesektor bist du mit den Prozessen von Energieversorgern vertraut. title: Werkstudent Sales – apeiron (m/w/d)
description: Werde Teil des Business Development Teams zur Förderung der neuen, innovativen apeiron-Plattform! Bei Ginmon arbeiten wir in einem Team aus jungen, visionären Experten daran, die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlichem Portfoliomanagement und modernster Kapitalmarkttechnologie zu schließen. Mit unserer Plattform helfen wir Privatanleger:innen, ihre finanziellen Ziele durch ETF-basierte Anlagestrategien effizient und kostengünstig zu erreichen. Nach unserem Erfolg im B2C-Bereich markiert das Jahr 2026 einen Meilenstein: den offiziellen Start von apeiron Wealth ( www.apeiron-wealth.com ). Dabei handelt es sich um unser zukunftsweisendes, KI-natives Betriebssystem für Vermögensberater:innen, das eine hochmoderne, vollautomatisierte Infrastruktur bietet. Diese ermöglicht es Vermögensberater:innen, ihr gesamtes Beratungsgeschäft zu digitalisieren und die Qualität sowie die Tiefe der Kundenbetreuung erheblich zu steigern. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Sales Team unterstützt du uns bei der Vermarktung des Produkts apeiron und der Generierung neuer Leads. Dabei sammelst du praxisnahe Einblicke in den Aufbau eines wachsenden B2B-Geschäfts. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für unser Produkt apeiron und dessen Marktvorteile, um potenzielle Kund:innen kompetent beraten zu können. Du initiierst den Erstkontakt zu unabhängigen Finanzberater:innen über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn) und vermittelst dabei einen professionellen und positiven Eindruck von apeiron. Du vereinbarst Termine mit unserem Business-Development-Manager und unserem CEO und hilfst mit, unsere Strategie zur Produktvermarktung mitzugestalten. Du pflegst und aktualisierst CRM-Datensätze sorgfältig, um eine datengestützte Sales-Pipeline zu gewährleisten. Du setzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude und Gemini sowie Prozessautomatisierung ein, um deine Arbeitsprozesse und die Effizienz im Business Development zu steigern. Du arbeitest in einem Team aus jungen, initiativen Menschen und bist dem Business Development Manager sowie dem CEO unterstellt. Dabei erwarten dich Perspektiven zur eigenständigen Übernahme von Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereichen, die dir helfen, dich zum Business Development Manager weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Profil Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit Schwerpunkt Kapitalmarkt, eingeschrieben und hast idealerweise noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir. Du bist kontaktfreudig, kommunikationsstark und trittst auch am Telefon sicher und professionell auf. Idealerweise bringst du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, im Vertrieb oder in der Beratung mit. Du begeisterst dich für innovative technologische Lösungen und KI und möchtest Arbeitsprozesse durch intelligente Tools maximal effizient gestalten. Du bist ein echter Teamplayer, kannst aber ebenso eigenständig agieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Leads und denkst proaktiv mit. Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (wichtig für die Kundenansprache) und verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Du wohnst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und arbeitest flexibel 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main. Was wir bieten Die Möglichkeit, den Markterfolg von apeiron Wealth aktiv mitzugestalten und die digitale Transformation der deutschen Vermögensberatung direkt zu beeinflussen. Maßgebliche Möglichkeiten zum Weiterlernen durch Workshops mit erfahrenen Professionals sowie gezielten Kompetenzaufbau. Direktes Reporting an den Business Development Manager und den CEO sowie flache Hierarchien mit viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen, perfekt, um wertvolle Business- und Vertriebserfahrung direkt vom Management zu sammeln. Ein internationales, junges und gleichgesinntes Team von Profis mit einer ausgeprägten "Get-things-done"-Mentalität und einer hervorragenden Arbeitsatmosphäre. Eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen Klausurenphase und Job dank flexibler Einteilung deiner 16 bis 20 Stunden. Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments, High-End-Equipment (auch für dein Studium nutzbar), regelmäßige Teamevents sowie eine moderne Büroatmosphäre inklusive Kaffeeflatrate, Snacks und Drinks. title: Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) SQL Server Administrator / Datenanalyst
description: Kommen Sie ins Team – gestalten Sie unsere Personalarbeit aktiv mit Hall Tabakwaren ist bundesweit in aller Munde. 1903 als Ladengeschäft für Zigarren, Rauchtabak und Zigaretten gegründet, sind wir heute einer der führenden Tabakwarengroßhändler in Deutschland. In unserem in 5. Generation inhabergeführten Familienunternehmen sorgen über 750 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in 11 Niederlassungen mit 330 firmeneigenen Fahrzeugen und 30.000 Cigarettenautomaten dafür, dass Menschen im gesamten Bundesgebiet schnell, sicher und zuverlässig zu ihrer Lieblingsmarke kommen. Mit unserer Erfahrung, unserer Leidenschaft und unserem Engagement – auch für unsere rund 4.300 Einzelhandelskunden – erwirtschaften wir jährlich mehr als 1 Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Und wir wachsen weiter, gerne mit dir als   SQL Server Administrator / Datenanalyst (m/w/d) Fokus: MS SQL Server & Dynamics NAV Standort: Hilden | Anstellungsart: Vollzeit / Unbefristet Deine Aufgaben – Das erwartet dich Datenbanken im Griff halten: Du betreust, wartest und optimierst unsere Microsoft SQL Server-Infrastruktur sowie unsere Dynamics NAV-Umgebung für einen reibungslosen Betrieb. Performance & Sicherheit: Du sorgst für schnelle Abfragen (Abfrageoptimierung), hohe Verfügbarkeit und verlässliche Datensicherungs- sowie Sicherheitskonzepte. Prozesse automatisieren: Mit T-SQL und PowerShell vereinfachst du wiederkehrende administrative Aufgaben und richtest automatisierte Jobs ein. Support & Fehlerbehebung: Du unterstützt bei der Fehleranalyse (2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support) in engem Austausch mit den Fachabteilungen und externen Partnern. Zukunft gestalten: Du hilfst bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenmodelle (ETL / SQL Server Integration Services) und begleitest spannende Projekte wie künftige Systemupgrades. Optionale Einblicke: Bei Interesse kannst du zudem Auswertungen oder Dashboards (z. B. mit Power BI) auf Basis unserer Datenquellen betreuen. Dein Profil – Das bringst du mit Fundierte Basis: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder Anwendungsentwicklung), ein Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift für die reibungslose Kommunikation mit Kollegen und Fachabteilungen. Praxiserfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft SQL Servern sowie ein solides Verständnis von Datenbank-Architekturen. Gute Skript-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit T-SQL und PowerShell-Skripting. Analytischer Kopf: Du hast Freude an der Strukturierung von Daten, denkst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich. description: Warum es diese Stelle gibt Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten. Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut. Was du machst Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert. Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen. Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material. Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme. Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten. Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels. Deine ersten 90 Tage Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live. Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus. Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen. Wen wir suchen Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig. Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text. Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung. Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung. Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei. Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei. Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem. Was wir bieten €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung. Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch. KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze. Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen. 30 Tage Urlaub. So bewirbst du dich Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie. Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann: 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst. Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

  • Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert.

  • Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

  • Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

  • Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

  • Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

  • Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

  • Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

  • Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig.

  • Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text.

  • Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung.

  • Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung.

  • Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei.

  • Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei.

Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Was wir bieten

  • €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch.

  • KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze.

  • Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie.

Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann:

  1. 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst.

  2. Eine Probeaufgabe von etwa 4 bis 5 Stunden: Markt anschauen, ein Testpaket entwickeln und ein Creative fertig bauen.

  3. 30 Minuten, in denen du uns die Probeaufgabe vorstellst und wir über die Erwartungen beider Seiten sprechen.

  4. Angebot, schriftlich. Vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin brauchen wir in der Regel zwei bis drei Wochen.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | United Kingdom | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h2><strong>Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend&nbsp;</strong></h2> <h4><strong>The Opportunity:&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.<br><br>You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.</p> <p>AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be accountable for the performance of <strong>two</strong> distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.</li> <li>Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.</li> <li>Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.</li> <li>Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.</li> <li>Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.</li> <li>Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.</li> <li>Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.</li> <li>Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.</li> <li>Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.</li> <li>Lead improvements across Grafana and R&amp;D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.</li> <li>Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.</li> <li>A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.</li> <li>A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.</li> <li>Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.</li> <li>An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.</li> <li>Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.</li> <li>Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.</li> <li>Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP <span data-sheets-root="1">117,949</span><span data-sheets-root="1">&nbsp;</span>- GBP <span data-sheets-root="1">141,539</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.</p> <p>Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.</p> <p>You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security &amp; Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI &amp; Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.</p> <p>Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.</li> <li>Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.</li> <li>Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.</li> <li>Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.</li> <li>Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.</li> <li>Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.</li> <li>Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.</li> <li>Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.</li> <li>Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.</li> <li>Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.</li> <li>The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.</li> <li>Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.</li> <li>Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li>Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.</li> </ul> <p>If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a title: Account Director (digital advertising Sales)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GumGum is The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising. We’re an advertising technology company delivering results by matching brands with people in the right mindset in the moments that matter. Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph™, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.</p> <p>We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.</p> <p>Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> We’re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.</li> <li><strong>Make it Happen:</strong> We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Always Innovate:</strong> We push boundaries with creativity and technology.</li> <li><strong>Foster Belonging:</strong> We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.</li> </ul> <p>To be a part of The Mindset Company™ transforming advertising, please visit <a href="http://www.gumgum.com/careers">www.gumgum.com/careers</a>.</p></div><p>The Account Director role is an individual contributor responsible for prospecting and closing sales in GumGum’s market-leading contextual advertising platform. Reporting to the NSW Sales Director, this role is responsible for developing key relationships within large and mid-size agencies, with occasional managerial guidance on client calls. We require this role to work relatively autonomously while being supported by a cross-functional pre-sales team.<br><br>Account Directors have experience and deep knowledge of the online media landscape and the advertising community and have at least 6+ years of digital media experience.&nbsp; The Account Director uses existing processes to solve a variety of challenging problems to deliver for clients. The role requires applying independent judgment and discretion to select appropriate options from GumGum’s defined and proven products.</p> <p>Note: GumGum fosters a hybrid flexible work environment. The Sales team collaborates in office 3 days per week: Tuesday-Thursday.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Achieve</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a $3M–$4M+ annual book of business across NSW, driving both renewal revenue and fresh new business</li> <li>Hunt for new opportunities through cold outreach, compelling presentations, RFP responses, and creative client entertainment</li> <li>Grow relationships with large and mid-sized agencies into long-term, strategic partnerships</li> <li>Turn marketing-generated leads into qualified pipeline and closed deals</li> <li>Expand current clients' investment by introducing them to GumGum's display and video offerings</li> <li>Become a trusted advisor to brands and agencies, understanding their goals and matching them with the right GumGum solutions</li> <li>Shape our product roadmap by bringing real client insight back to the Product team</li> <li>Partner with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to make sure every proposal lands and delivers on client expectations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>A bachelor's degree in Media, Marketing, or Advertising is preferred</li> <li>6+ years of digital advertising sales experience, with a proven track record of hitting or exceeding targets</li> <li>Experience managing a large book of business, plus hands-on programmatic expertise</li> <li>Strong, strategic relationships across Australian agencies</li> <li>Confidence in Salesforce — logging meetings and calls, pulling reports, and keeping your pipeline sharp</li> <li>Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for building strategic client relationships</li> <li>A sharp eye for detail and organisation, plus quick problem-solving while guiding stakeholders through the process</li> <li>Solid business acumen (P&amp;L, COGS, revenue drivers) and the analytical judgment to craft smart solutions from data</li> </ul> <p>Learn about our benefits &amp; perks package at <a href="http://gumgum.com/benefits">gumgum.com/benefits</a>. If you'd like additional information, your recruiter can share more specifics during the hiring process!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Awards</strong></p> <ul> <li>2025 &amp; 2026 Digiday Media Awards Europe Best Contextual Targeting Offering</li> <li>2025 AdExchanger Awards AI Innovators, Technology &amp; Service Provider, Finalist</li> <li>2025 MARKETECH APAC Marketing Technology Awards Silver Winner for Best Contextual Advertising Tech Platform</li> </ul> <p>We're always learning and evolving as a company, and we continue to take thoughtful steps to support our people and strengthen our culture.</p> <p><strong>Follow Us on Social</strong></p> <ul> <li>Instagram: @gumgum</li> <li>LinkedIn: <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/">https://www.linkedin.com/company/gumgum/</a></li> <li>YouTube: @GumGumInc</li> <li>TikTok: @itsgumgum<br><br><strong>Beware of recruitment scams.</strong> GumGum recruits only for active roles on our careers page, accepts applications through Greenhouse, and communicates only via LinkedIn or ----- / ----- email addresses. We never use chat apps, ask you to register on other recruiting sites, or request financial information, payments or purchases. <a href="https://gumgum.com/contact">Verify suspicious outreach</a> before sharing personal information.</li> </ul></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p></p> <h1 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Forward Deployed Engineer</h1> <h2>About HSO</h2> <p>HSO is a global Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and a long standing strategic relationship with Microsoft. We help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to modernise operations, accelerate innovation and deliver meaningful business outcomes.</p> <p>In 2026, HSO achieved Microsoft Frontier Partner status, recognising our advanced capabilities across Microsoft Cloud and AI and our ability to help customers move beyond AI experimentation into secure, governed, enterprise scale production.</p> <p>With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, we combine industry knowledge, technical excellence and a practical, people first approach to transformation.</p> <p>As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we’re building a new generation of customer facing engineering talent to help organisations turn the potential of AI and agentic technologies into real, measurable value.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>HSO is building a new generation of customer facing engineers who will help our customers create the operating model of the future using the latest AI, data and cloud capabilities.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineers combine consulting judgement, production software engineering, data platform expertise, AI delivery capability and business transformation skills.</p> <p>You will embed with strategic customers, understand their most important business challenges and rapidly turn those challenges into working, production ready AI applications, agentic workflows, automation solutions and data driven platforms.</p> <p>This is a hands on, outcome led role embedded within customer environments. You’ll move quickly from discovery to working software and take accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll work across business processes, data platforms, integrations, AI, cloud and security, designing solutions that make effective use of Microsoft technologies while integrating with the customer’s wider technology estate.</p> <p>A strong understanding of modern enterprise data platforms is fundamental to the role. You will need to understand how data is structured, governed, integrated, transformed and made available to AI and application workloads, and how data platform decisions affect the quality, scalability and reliability of the solutions you build.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineers work closely with Deployment Strategists. The Deployment Strategist focuses on identifying where AI can create the greatest customer value and defining the desired outcome. The FDE takes ownership of how that outcome is delivered technically.</p> <p>From discovery through to go live, both roles work side by side. The FDE owns the technical solution and delivery, while the Deployment Strategist ensures the solution remains aligned to the business problem and measurable value.</p> <p>The role does not end at first deployment. You’ll stay close to solutions through hardening, adoption and handover before moving on to the next value opportunity. You’ll also turn what you learn into reusable HSO assets, reference architectures and delivery patterns that help future engagements move faster.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <h3>Own Customer Outcomes</h3> <p>• Embed rapidly within customer teams and develop a strong understanding of their priorities, operating processes, systems, data and constraints.</p> <p>• Translate ambiguous business problems and defined customer outcomes into clear technical delivery plans.</p> <p>• Act as the technical lead throughout an engagement, guiding customer sponsors, business users, technical teams and HSO colleagues towards successful delivery.</p> <p>• Build trusted relationships with senior operational and technical stakeholders, including CTO and CIO level leaders.</p> <p>• Take ownership for delivering solutions that create measurable customer value rather than simply completing technical tasks.</p> <h3>Lead Discovery and Solution Design</h3> <p>• Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer challenges and identify high value AI, data and automation opportunities.</p> <p>• Assess business processes, data readiness, data architecture, integration points, security requirements, technical risks and operational constraints.</p> <p>• Understand the customer’s existing data platform landscape and identify how data needs to be accessed, transformed, governed or modernised to support the required solution.</p> <p>• Apply a problem first approach to identify the smallest valuable solution that can be built and proven quickly.</p> <p>• Design end to end solution architectures that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, security and responsible AI.</p> <p>• Turn discovery into a pragmatic roadmap from prototype through to production.</p> <h3>Build and Ship Production Solutions</h3> <p>• Design, build, integrate, test and deploy enterprise grade solutions using modern cloud, data and AI technologies.</p> <p>• Develop AI powered applications, copilots, agents, automations, integrations and workflow solutions.</p> <p>• Build solutions that make effective use of modern enterprise data platforms and ensure AI applications are supported by reliable, governed and accessible data.</p> <p>• Integrate solutions with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow and customer owned systems, APIs and data platforms.</p> <p>• Apply modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability and secure development.</p> <p>• Work iteratively. Deliver value quickly, learn from real world usage and progressively harden solutions for enterprise production.</p> <h3>Engineer AI and Agentic Solutions</h3> <p>• Design and implement robust agentic workflows, human in the loop processes and, where appropriate, multi agent architectures.</p> <p>• Apply modern techniques across retrieval, grounding, orchestration, tool integration, context engineering and evaluation.</p> <p>• Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails to test AI behaviour, reliability and quality before and after deployment.</p> <p>• Implement appropriate responsible AI, security, monitoring and governance controls.</p> <p>• Ensure data quality, lineage, governance and availability are considered as fundamental components of AI solution design.</p> <p>• Use operational data and user feedback to continuously improve solution quality and performance.</p> <h3>Create Reusable HSO Capability</h3> <p>• Reuse existing HSO assets, accelerators and delivery patterns wherever they improve speed and quality.</p> <p>• Turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable assets, reference architectures, engineering patterns and playbooks.</p> <p>• Contribute actively to HSO’s AI, Data, Frontier and Horizon engineering communities.</p> <p>• Share practical knowledge across regions, practices and delivery teams.</p> <p>• Support and mentor other engineers as the Forward Deployed Engineering capability grows.</p> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>We’re looking for experienced engineers who combine strong technical depth with commercial awareness and the ability to operate confidently with customers.</p> <p>You’ll ideally bring:</p> <p>• Significant experience across software engineering, cloud engineering, data engineering, solution development, technical consulting or enterprise technology delivery, with senior level ownership of complex solutions.</p> <p>• Strong hands on experience building and operating production grade solutions on at least one major cloud platform.</p> <p>• Strong understanding and practical experience of modern enterprise data platforms, including data architecture, integration, transformation, governance and the role data plays in enabling AI and application workloads.</p> <p>• Experience with Microsoft data technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, OneLake or comparable enterprise data platforms would be highly valuable.</p> <p>• Excellent coding capability in a modern language such as Python, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript or Java, with a track record of producing maintainable, production quality software.</p> <p>• Practical experience designing, building and deploying AI powered applications using platforms such as Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic or comparable technologies.</p> <p>• Hands on experience with large language models, prompting, retrieval augmented generation, evaluation and agent orchestration.</p> <p>• Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, data platforms and modern distributed application architectures.</p> <p>• Experience with modern engineering and DevOps practices including CI/CD, automated testing, source control and infrastructure as code.</p> <p>• Strong customer facing experience in consulting, transformation, delivery or technical leadership.</p> <p>• The ability to work effectively where requirements are incomplete, priorities evolve quickly and the right answer is not immediately obvious.</p> <p>• The judgement to balance engineering excellence with speed, practicality and customer value.</p> <p>You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use. More important is the ability to learn quickly, understand unfamiliar environments and apply strong engineering and data fundamentals to new problems.</p> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <p>• Certifications across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Google Cloud or leading AI platforms.</p> <p>• Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow or similar.</p> <p>• Experience implementing responsible AI, AI governance, evaluation frameworks or model monitoring in enterprise environments.</p> <p>• Experience designing or delivering modern data platforms that support analytics, operational applications or AI workloads.</p> <p>• Experience across industries such as Manufacturing, Retail, Financial Services, Public Sector or Professional Services.</p> <p>• A track record of turning successful customer solutions into reusable patterns or accelerators.</p> <p>• Experience leading small, highly capable engineering teams from discovery through to production.</p> <h2>Why Join HSO?</h2> <p>AI is changing how organisations operate, but most businesses do not need more demonstrations or isolated pilots. They need people who can identify where AI will genuinely create value, ensure the underlying data foundations are fit for purpose and then build something that works in production.</p> <p>That is what this role is designed to do.</p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at HSO, you’ll work directly with strategic customers at the point where emerging AI, data and cloud capabilities meet real business problems.</p> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to:</p> <p>• Build real AI products and solutions rather than proof of concepts that never reach production.</p> <p>• Work across AI, cloud and data platforms to solve complex customer problems end to end.</p> <p>• Work directly with senior customer stakeholders and see the impact of what you build.</p> <p>• Operate at the forefront of Microsoft’s evolving AI and Data ecosystem as part of a Microsoft Frontier Partner.</p> <p>• Work across technologies, industries and business problems rather than being confined to a single product or platform.</p> <p>• Help shape a new engineering capability within HSO rather than stepping into a narrowly defined existing model.</p> <p>• Turn successful customer work into reusable technology and approaches that can scale across HSO globally.</p> <p>You’ll join a senior, practical and customer focused team that values ownership, curiosity, engineering quality, speed and measurable impact.</p> <h2>Compensation and Benefits</h2> <p>We offer a competitive base salary alongside HSO’s standard employee benefits.</p> <p>The role will also include a performance related element designed to recognise both individual contribution and the value created through successful customer delivery. Further details on the compensation structure and performance measures will be discussed during the recruitment process.</p> <p></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Treasury Manager - UK
description: <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Location: London<br>Type: Full-time</strong></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div> <div data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">BW ESS is seeking an experienced Senior Treasury Manager to take ownership of the Group's treasury activities across its international corporate entities, project SPVs and joint ventures.</div> <div data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">&nbsp;</div> <div>As BW ESS continues to grow, the complexity and importance of treasury is increasing materially. This role will bring together activities currently undertaken across different parts of the organisation, establish clear ownership and controls, and build a scalable treasury capability for the Group.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can both design the right treasury framework and make sure it operates effectively day to day. We are looking for candidates with real ownership experience in complex, multi-entity, multi-currency environments, ideally gained in energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities or another project- and SPV-based business.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About BW ESS</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects.&nbsp;The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain, and Sweden. It has more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with ~12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.</div> </div> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>To find out more, visit: <a href="https://bw-ess.com/">https://bw-ess.com/</a></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">The Role</strong></div> <div>Reporting to the Director of FP&amp;A and Treasury, you will work closely with the CFO, Strategic Finance, Portfolio FP&amp;A, Accounting, Tax, Investments, Legal and project teams, as well as BW Group and the Group's banking counterparties.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>You will be responsible for Group cash and liquidity management, credit support, FX and hedging operations, cash investment, banking and treasury facilities, treasury governance and treasury systems.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>Your objective is to replace fragmented activity with a coherent Group treasury capability: giving management reliable visibility of cash, liquidity and treasury risk, ensuring cash and credit resources are deployed efficiently, strengthening controls and banking infrastructure, and building processes and systems that scale with the business.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>Cash management: own the consolidated Group cash position across corporate entities, project SPVs, joint ventures, accounts and currencies, including restricted and unrestricted cash, intercompany funding, equity contributions and distributions, and ensuring the right cash sits in the right entity, account and currency ahead of material payment obligations.</div> </li> <li> <div>Liquidity management: own the Group liquidity position and rolling forecast, consolidating inputs from Portfolio FP&amp;A, Accounting, Investments, Strategic Finance and project teams, and providing forward-looking analysis of requirements, constraints, surpluses and funding needs across multiple currencies and jurisdictions.</div> </li> <li> <div>Credit support: own the portfolio of bank guarantees, parent-company guarantees, letters of credit and other contingent exposures, managing issuance, amendment, renewal and cancellation, and monitoring utilisation, expiries, fees, collateral and facility headroom.</div> </li> <li> <div>FX management: own the consolidated view of forecast and actual FX exposures across development, construction, operations and corporate activity, maintain the Group's FX framework, recommend hedging actions, and execute approved transactions within delegated authorities.</div> </li> <li> <div>Cash investment: manage surplus cash within approved policies and counterparty limits, optimising deposit arrangements, managing counterparty exposure and diversification, and negotiating terms to improve returns while preserving liquidity.</div> </li> <li> <div>Hedging operations: own the operational management of FX and interest-rate derivatives, including execution, confirmation, settlement, records of hedges and maturities, collateral and threshold monitoring, and treasury inputs into valuation, accounting and reporting.</div> </li> <li> <div>Banking and facilities: act as principal treasury relationship owner for cash-management and transaction banks, maintain the Group's banking architecture (accounts, mandates, signatories, access, KYC and documentation), own treasury-related facilities, and support complex funds flows for acquisitions, disposals, financings, refinancings and project financial close.</div> </li> <li> <div>Controls, policy and governance: own treasury policies, procedures, delegated authorities and the control framework, ensure transactions are authorised, documented, reconciled and auditable, monitor compliance with policy and counterparty limits, and report to senior management and governance forums.</div> </li> <li> <div>Systems and transformation: define the future treasury operating model, lead Treasury's contribution to the Group's ERP implementation, drive automation of cash visibility, forecasting, payments and bank-statement collection, and assess the role and timing of a dedicated Treasury Management System.</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>Required Skills and Experience</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>10+ years' relevant experience in corporate treasury, infrastructure, energy, banking or a closely related finance role.</div> </li> <li> Own selected initiatives from discovery through delivery, working with stakeholders to connect each idea to a clear programme outcome. Run experiments that lead to decisions: State the opportunity and hypothesis, then agree the success measure and threshold before building. Create the smallest useful experiment, use a feature flag or controlled rollout where appropriate, and measure against a control or baseline at an agreed review date. Embed quality and responsible use: Work with Platform, SRE, Cyber and governance colleagues to build evaluation, observability, access controls and appropriate human oversight into AI-enabled services and workflows. Help teams understand failure modes and make support, recovery and ownership arrangements clear. Develop capability in others: Mentor graduate and less experienced engineers, and work with learning and enablement colleagues to address practical skills gaps. Build teams’ confidence and ability to maintain what they adopt. And what will you need? Software engineering and delivery: Strong Python or TypeScript skills and experience taking prototypes into production, including APIs, cloud deployment (preferably AWS), automated testing, CI/CD and observability. Practical AI engineering: Experience building LLM applications, agents or automations, using AI coding tools effectively, and improving results through evals and error analysis. Familiarity with context, reusable skills and integrations through APIs or MCP. Initiative and product judgement: Evidence of spotting opportunities, creating useful solutions without a fully defined brief, and owning delivery from idea to outcome. Experimentation and evaluation: Ability to define hypotheses and success measures before building, run focused experiments against a baseline or control, and use evidence to decide what happens next. Sound engineering judgement: Ability to balance quality, reliability, security and cost, evaluate AI behaviour, and choose maintainable solutions with appropriate data access and human oversight. Technical evangelism and collaboration: Clear communication through demos, tech talks, workshops and written guides. Experience partnering with teams, mentoring engineers and helping others adopt effective practices. What benefits will you get?   25 days annual leave, plus the bank holiday allowance. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.&nbsp;</strong></p> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">The New York Times is continuing to expand its video journalism, identifying compelling visual stories across the depth and breadth of our reporting. We showcase the expertise of Times journalists on camera, share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting, and pioneer Visual Investigations.</p> <p>The Video department is looking for a Senior Producer to work on the multi-disciplinary Reporter Video team of video journalists who create powerful videos featuring the expertise of our world-class journalists. Based in London, this role will focus on covering breaking news and major international developments in short-form video, producing a mix of quick-turnaround videos, explanatory and analysis pieces, as well as major enterprise and investigations.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Senior Producer will report to a London supervisor and work with the rest of the Reporter Video team in New York and other video hubs, becoming the key manager of the department’s content during the hours that London acts as the main Times hub.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for a strong leader who is eager to motivate, inspire teams and innovate. Attention to detail, impeccable organization and effective communication with reporters and editors in the International Desk are a must.</p> <p>You should also be an excellent storyteller with an eye for visual short-form digital formats, able to work autonomously to identify critical stories outside the U.S. and make sound, quick editorial decisions on world news. You will be expected to produce engaging stories through original reporting, on-the-ground filming, motion graphics and studio-based recordings.</p> <p>You must have deep experience reporting on stories from Europe, the Middle East and Africa, including managing teams in conflict zones, devising security plans and making risk assessments.</p> <p>This is a hybrid position based in London and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Drive innovative Reporter Video delivering on a range of formats.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and strengthen relations with colleagues on the International Desk, including mentorship of reporters, photographers and fellow editors on the reporter video storytelling format.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead story development and story edits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Review, assign and provide feedback on productions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support and guide script writing and visual approaches for effective short-form video.</p> </li> <li> <p>Oversee production across multiple projects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Guide interviews and shoots as needed, both in studio and field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Foster experiments with new video approaches and editorial strategies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage video journalists and video editors in the newsroom and field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.</p> </li> <li> <p>This role reports to the Supervising Producer in London.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Basic Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Proven experience producing digital news videos.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing video journalists, also during field deployments, including in hostile environments and involving risk assessments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Broad and in depth experience in digital or broadcast news.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record managing direct reports.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated deep command of a variety of video sources, including wire services, UGC, archival footage, motion graphics, and original footage.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Expert knowledge of current events with advanced-level experience covering breaking news stories in the U.S. and internationally.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience overseeing shoots and interviewing experts on camera.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiar with digital storytelling formats.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of mainstream and emerging social channels</p> </li> <li> <p>Flexibility to work extended hours.</p> </li> </ul> <p>REQ-020816</p> <p><strong>Additional Compensation and Benefits</strong><br><br>For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.<br><br>For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:</strong></p> <p>We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.</p> <p>If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.</p> <hr> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization.
