title: Director of Financial Risk
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE ROLE:&nbsp;</h3> <p>At Tide, we're building the leading financial platform for small businesses. As we continue to grow across multiple markets, strong financial risk management is essential to helping us scale safely, responsibly and sustainably.</p> <p>As our <strong>Director of Financial Risk</strong>, you'll lead our global 2LOD Financial Risk team and shape how we identify, assess and oversee financial risks across the business. You'll own our financial risk framework while providing independent oversight, challenge and trusted advice to 1LOD teams across:</p> <ul> <li>Financial Reporting &amp; Control (statutory &amp; regulatory accounting),&nbsp;</li> <li>FP&amp;A (management accounting &amp; commercial finance),&nbsp;</li> <li>Finance Operations (including account operations, reconciliations, AP &amp; AR, payroll)</li> <li>Treasury</li> <li>Finance Product (systems support for Finance).</li> <li>Corporate Development (for any CorDev working impacting FinRisk)</li> </ul> <p>As well as the Regional Heads/Directors of Finance that coordinate these functions for their region (UK, EU, India).</p> <p>This is a highly visible leadership role, and you’ll be at the forefront of scaling in new markets, working on new licences, and new products. We are looking for not just a deep subject matter expert, but a trusted leader to help us scale whilst managing our financial risks.&nbsp; You will need to be a strong collaborator, as you'll work closely with a variety of stakeholders, from senior leadership and executives to auditors and banking partners, to ensure Tide remains financially resilient while continuing to innovate for our members.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING</h3> <p>This is a global role in which you will:</p> <ul> <li>Own and evolve Tide's Financial Risk Management Framework, ensuring it grows with the business as we expand into new markets, launch new products and operate under new licences.</li> <li>Provide independent oversight and challenge of 1LOD activities relating to financial risks, working mostly with Finance and Treasury. You need to be deeply familiar with how a global Treasury function works, to be able to identify and manage risks arising.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure alignment of financial risk governance across all regulated entities and jurisdictions.</li> <li>Maintain and enhance financial risk appetite metrics, limits, triggers, and escalation protocols.</li> <li>Deliver clear and independent reporting to Group and entity-level Risk &amp; Compliance Committees and Boards.</li> <li>Monitor capital adequacy, liquidity, concentration risks, and financial resilience.</li> <li>Support regulatory engagements, audits, thematic reviews, and licence applications.</li> <li>Independently oversee treasury and liquidity management activities.</li> <li>Review and challenge liquidity forecasting methodologies and stress assumptions.</li> <li>Maintain existing risk policies and frameworks, and develop new ones as required.</li> <li>Lead financial risk assessments for new products, partnerships, and market launches.</li> <li>Partner with other Risk &amp; Compliance teams, various Finance teams, Legal and Internal Audit teams to ensure integrated risk management.</li> <li>Present concise and insightful risk reporting to Risk &amp; Compliance Committees, and lead on the Financial Risk Working Groups</li> <li>Lead a high-performing and experienced global financial risk team.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <p>We're looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with excellent judgement and the ability to influence across the organisation.</p> <p>You'll likely have:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Financial Risk within fintech, payments, e-money, banking or another regulated financial services environment.</li> <li>Experience operating in a 2LOD leadership role.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of financial risk frameworks within payment institutions, e-money institutions or digital banking.</li> <li>Deep expertise across treasury, liquidity, solvability, capital, solvency, statutory reporting and tax risk.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Accounting expertise; ideally with an accounting qualification.</li> <li>Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions and engaging directly with regulators and auditors.</li> <li>The ability to balance strong risk management with commercial ambition in a fast-moving business.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and provide independent challenge when it matters.</li> <li>A collaborative leadership style, with experience building and developing high-performing teams.</li> </ul> <p>Most importantly, you'll enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable navigating change, and care about helping Tide build a resilient business that continues to deliver for our members.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation -&nbsp; competitive salary and share options</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement</li> <li>Snacks &amp; Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. In this role, you'll be instrumental in driving product adoption and ensuring the success of our customers through a combination of tailored 1:1 engagements and scalable 1:many initiatives. You'll leverage your technical expertise to guide customers through their journey, provide best practice guidance, and contribute to the evolution of our digital enablement programs.</p> <p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Customer Adoption &amp; Enablement:</strong> <strong>Drive Customer Adoption &amp; Enablement: </strong>Develop and deliver impactful enablement materials that boost product adoption and deliver quantifiable business results for our customers.</li> <li><strong>Provide Technical Expertise &amp; Guidance:</strong> Act as a trusted technical advisor, offering in-depth product knowledge and troubleshooting assistance to resolve complex customer issues.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to 1:Many Initiatives:</strong> Collaborate with Customer Advocacy and CX Operations teams to contribute to and participate in 1:many content, including webinars, workshops, and educational materials, to drive broad customer understanding and adoption.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Customer Engagement:</strong> Engage with customers on a strategic level, identifying their business needs and aligning them with our product capabilities to drive successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Customer Advocacy &amp; Feedback:</strong> Serve as a vital feedback loop, collaborating with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, CX Operations) to champion customer needs, influence product enhancements, and contribute to our digital program's content strategy.</li> <li><strong>Data Analysis &amp; Optimization:</strong> Utilize data to understand customer behavior, identify common pain points, and contribute insights to optimize both 1:1 and 1:many engagement strategies.</li> <li><strong>Churn Mitigation &amp; Growth:</strong> Proactively identify churn risks and develop strategies to retain and grow the customer base by demonstrating ongoing value.</li> <li><strong>Process Improvement &amp; Automation:</strong> Identify opportunities to leverage automation and other digital tools to enhance efficiency and personalize the scaled customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Measure &amp; Report:</strong> Track key metrics related to customer health, adoption, and engagement, reporting on the effectiveness of your efforts and continuously seeking improvements.</li> <li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of the data observability and security space, including technologies like SIEM, APM, logging, and metrics. You can build rapport quickly and effectively address diverse customer needs.</li> <li>Problem-Solving &amp; Analytical Skills: Exceptional ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges, analyze data to identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.</li> <li>Strategic Thinking: Capability to understand customer business objectives and translate them into actionable product adoption strategies.</li> <li>Content Creation &amp; Delivery: Experience in creating and delivering compelling technical content, including presentations, documentation, and live sessions (e.g., webinars).</li> <li>Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with product, engineering, sales, marketing, and other customer-facing teams.</li> <li>Project Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience with Customer Success Tools: Familiarity with customer success platforms (e.g., Gainsight) and analytics tools is a plus.</li> <li>BONUS<strong>:</strong><br> <ul> <li>Experience in a similar scaled customer success or technical account management role.</li> <li>Experience with various cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li> <li>Willingness to learn</li> <li>Multi-lingual (French, Spanish, and/or German)</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>#LI-KM1<br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The salary for this role is dependent on country of employment and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.<br><br>In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). title: Senior Sales Manager - Issuing
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. We need a high-achieving individual to help global enterprises launch modern card programs—from virtual cards for travel intermediaries to physical cards for BNPL. If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge issuing solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan. Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive. How You’ll Make an Impact Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals. Solution Selling: Sell our issuing products to travel intermediaries and fintech clients through outbound techniques. Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert. Proposal Management: Prepare thorough presentations and proposals that highlight the ROI of switching to a modern issuer. Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders. Collaboration: Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends Market Intelligence: Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information What We’re Looking For Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing. Network: A solid network of potential prospects and partners. AI & Productivity: Proficient in leveraging AI-powered sales tools to augment prospecting and analyze deal intelligence to accelerate the sales cycle. Technical Passion: Tech-savvy with a passion for how technology is transforming finance. Business Acumen: Solid understanding of financial factors, including interchange mechanics and card scheme products. Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation techniques, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals. Tools: Knowledge of Salesforce and a highly organized approach to prioritizing shifting workloads. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com are actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in London to drive rapid growth for our revolutionary Card Issuing solution. We need a high-achieving individual to help global enterprises launch modern card programs—from virtual cards for travel intermediaries to physical cards for BNPL.

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge issuing solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan.

Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets.

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive.

 

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals.

  • Solution Selling: Sell our issuing products to travel intermediaries and fintech clients through outbound techniques.

  • Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert.

  • Proposal Management: Prepare thorough presentations and proposals that highlight the ROI of switching to a modern issuer.

  • Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends

  • Market Intelligence: Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing.

  • Network: A solid network of potential prospects and partners.

  • AI & Productivity: Proficient in leveraging AI-powered sales tools to augment prospecting and analyze deal intelligence to accelerate the sales cycle.

  • Technical Passion: Tech-savvy with a passion for how technology is transforming finance.

  • Business Acumen: Solid understanding of financial factors, including interchange mechanics and card scheme products.

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation techniques, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Tools: Knowledge of Salesforce and a highly organized approach to prioritizing shifting workloads.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll help define what strategic success looks like at incident.io , and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability. What that looks like day to day You’ll work with a small number of our largest, most complex and highest-value customers. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You’ll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO. You’ll help land strategic logos with focused first contracts, then build the business case and success plan that turns them into larger deals. From there you’ll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You’ll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity. You’ll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. You’ll spot and reduce business, operational and reputational risk before it becomes visible, and bring Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing and Support together around shared goals for each account, including expansion and renewals. You’ll also work directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap and design partnerships. As the first EMEA Strategic CSM and third on the team overall, you’ll help define our strategic CS playbook, support high-stakes deals and help develop your peers as the segment grows. Who you are You have significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management, managing strategic or Fortune 500-scale accounts in enterprise SaaS. Traditional enterprises like financial services, insurance, pharma, retail or private equity are ideal. Developer tooling, observability or incident management is a plus. You’ve driven adoption, retention and expansion in large, complex accounts with many stakeholders, and you have results you can point to. You know how to land small and grow large, turning a pilot or single business unit into a multi-BU footprint over a long sales cycle. Building a business case doesn’t faze you, nor does navigating procurement, security, legal and change management in slow-moving organisations. You’re confident with senior technical executives, running EBRs and strategic planning sessions, and just as comfortable going deep with SREs and platform engineers. You’re technically fluent in modern engineering organisations, on-call, incident response, SRE practices and the observability and DevOps ecosystem, and you can translate it for business stakeholders. You have strong commercial judgement, partner well with Sales on renewals and expansion, and get ahead of customer challenges rather than reacting to them. You’re autonomous and comfortable with ambiguity. You’re excited to define the role, not just step into it. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We’re rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We’re all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we’re doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Client Partner: Torchbox Public Sector
raw.description:
Job Description

Base salary: from £54,669 - £75,000 + per annum*

All salaries listed on our roles are based on UK salary bands, however if you’d like more information on the bands for your country give us a shout.

We are looking for a Client Partner to join our Public Sector team

A bit about Torchbox
We build digital products for international NGOs, governments and universities; and we created Wagtail CMS, used by Google, NASA, the NHS and thousands more. 

Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world.

We are on a mission to set a new standard for a purpose-led business. Torchbox is 100% employee-owned - everyone is a co-owner from day one and we are building an amazing, progressive ownership and learning culture. If you are excited about this mission, it’s a great time to join.


What we’re looking for

We are seeking an experienced Client Partner to join our team. Your experience might be in Product or Service Ownership, Delivery Management, or Consulting with a digital agency. 

While account management experience is useful, we are particularly looking for candidates with client-side public sector experience, particularly in navigating complex digital projects and helping clients implement the government Service Standard. You’ll have strong experience in helping clients develop and implement effective digital services and interventions.
We recognise that candidates may not have deep expertise in every aspect of the role, so we’re open to different backgrounds. Whether you lean more towards Delivery or Product is less important than your ability to build strong relationships, guide clients through challenges, and contribute to sales efforts.

In this role, progression will be about the complexity and scale of projects and clients rather than a traditional management track. 

We’re generally a curious, creative, and caring team. If you’re passionate about helping public sector clients navigate complex challenges, improve services, and create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!


You will:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of public sector clients, ensuring their digital strategies align with their goals.

  • Lead combined multidisciplinary and client teams through exploration, experimentation, and implementation, drawing on relevant research, design, and technical approaches.

  • Provide the strategic direction to support teams in working in agile, iterative ways to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Work alongside a Delivery Manager, enabling you to hold the vision and strategic direction

  • Act as a navigator through relevant sector standards, helping clients understand the Service Standard and what it means for their work.

  • Facilitate conversations and run workshops confidently, getting hands-on with collaborative and multidisciplinary work.

  • Help teams translate policy intent into viable digital products or services that can be operated effectively.

  • Contribute to business development, supporting the growth of our public sector work by identifying opportunities, leading pitches, and shaping proposals.


Core responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with senior public sector stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor across projects

  • Strategic Leadership: Guide clients in developing and implementing strategies that improve public services, exploring new and different approaches to realise positive outcomes and add value.

  • Project Oversight: Oversee planning and execution of digital projects, coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Business Development: Identify opportunities for growth within existing client accounts and play a key role in securing new projects.

  • Performance Analysis: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to measure impact and inform decision-making.

  • User-centred and agile working: create the conditions for collaborative, multidisciplinary work across research, design, innovation, and enabling technology. 


Skills & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Service Standard approaches, user-centred design disciplines, and iterative working methods.

  • Experience in a Product, Delivery, or Service Lead role with a focus on agile, user-centred service and product development.

  • Ability to build trust and long-term relationships with public sector clients.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with confidence in presenting to clients and stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a sales-involved role, identifying opportunities and supporting business growth.

  • A results-oriented mindset, with a track record of driving impactful digital projects.


What we offer

  • Become a co-owner of Torchbox, shape our success and share in the rewards 

  • Work with awesome clients doing rewarding, purposeful work

  • Competitive salary + annual review + bonuses

  • Ethical pension scheme, with a 6% contribution from Torchbox

  • 27 days holiday, plus public holidays

  • Fully remote, hybrid, office full-time, whatever works for you

  • Training and conference budget to discover new ideas

  • Paid time off to volunteer for causes that matter to you 

  • Health schemes and access to mental health support

  • Electric car salary sacrifice scheme (UK only)

  • Wellness programme and cycle-to-work scheme, alongside other lovely things that are good for you and the environment

  • Some pretty epic socials (virtual and in-person), weekly free veggie lunches in the offices  and a bunch of other cool stuff we’d love to tell you about


The money bit

* As an employee-owned company our remuneration is made up of two parts, your base salary £54,669 - £75,000+  and your tax-free co-owner bonus of £3,600 which is prorated and paid quarterly. There is an additional profit share scheme.


The application process

The role will close on Monday 19th October 2026.
 The application process will consist of 3 stages:

  • Submit your CV and a covering letter demonstrating your expertise

  • 30-minute first-stage interview, we will ask you more about your previous work experience and skills.  You’ll also get a chance to learn more about Torchbox and the role.

  • A 90-minute panel stage interview, will be a panel interview with 3 members of the team. We will delve more into your experience and ask you some competency-based questions. During this stage, we’d like you to complete a 10-minute presentation, we will send you details in advance.


Everyone is welcome
We’re committed to being an inclusive employer, from recruitment to everyday life. If you need
help or have questions - give us a shout - 
No agencies, please.

title: Business developer CEE senior
description: Créée en 2010, la société Vos Travaux Eco est né du constat suivant : économies d’énergie et préservation de l’environnement sont devenus des enjeux sociétaux majeurs. A l’échelle européenne d’abord, où le secteur du bâtiment représente 43% de la consommation énergétique et près de 25% des émissions de CO2. Et à l’échelle européenne ensuite, avec l’adoption de la Directive sur l’efficacité énergétique du 25.10.2010. Mais une série de questions demeure : par où commencer? Comment réduire sa facture énergétique? Quels travaux réaliser? Et surtout comment les financer? Grâce à la création d’outils digitaux innovants, la société a contribué à fournir un service novateur aux particuliers et à promouvoir les économies d’énergie d’une manière différente : l’information et le conseil en économies d’énergie notamment avec un portail d’information gratuit pour les particuliers; l’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage allant de l’identification des travaux jusqu’à leur réalisation en passant par le choix d’un artisan RGE qualifié ; le financement des travaux grâce au dispositif des Certificats d’Economie d’Energie. Avec ses applications, l’entreprise compte parmi les principaux producteurs de Certificats d’économies d’énergie en France et a déjà reversé plus de 184 millions d’euros à près de 201.000 foyers. Acteur engagé, Vos Travaux Eco fait partie des premiers signataires du dispositif « Coup de pouce Chauffage et Rénovation Globale » mis en place par le Ministère de la Transition écologique et solidaire, et propose plusieurs programmes « clés en main » pour lutter contre la précarité énergétique. Vos travaux Eco est engagé dans une démarche qualité de ses activités dans le cadre de la certification ISO 9001. Vos missions Vos missions Développement de partenariats commerciaux CEE stratégiques (prospection, négociation et mise en œuvre ) Signature de partenariats grand compte pour obtenir des contacts en amont dans les domaines suivants : Coup de pouce chauffage individuel, collectif et tertiaire Coup de pouce Rénovation Globale en résidentiel collectif Rénovation Energétique de grands ensembles immobiliers Plus généralement, toutes opérations d’économies d’énergie Définition / amélioration de l’offre de vente de contacts commerciaux à nos artisans partenaires (abonnement, prix, type de leads) Mise en place d’un réseau de partenaires artisans pour réaliser les travaux d’économies d’énergie que nous préconisons, ou pour l’achat de leads commerciaux Développement de la stratégie de requalification des contacts commerciaux bruts Développer les ventes complémentaires et de nouvelles offres de services énergétiques Animation commerciale Plus généralement, participer à la structuration de l’entreprise et à la stratégie Marketing, Digitale et commerciale. Vos compétences Dynamique, volontaire et ambitieux, vous cherchez à intégrer une équipe soudée et impliquée dans la réussite de l’aventure VOS TRAVAUX ECO. De Formation: BAC +4/5 Ecole de commerce, vous justifiez d’une expérience réussie dans le domaine du développement commerciale, de l’acquisition de trafic sur Internet en lien avec la maîtrise de l’énergie, des certificats d’économies d’énergie (C2E) ou de la rénovation énergétique des bâtiments ; Vous êtes convaincant, enthousiaste et innovant. title: Chef de Projet/Consultant Fonctionnel GTA
description: Traxxeo est un éditeur de logiciels de Gestion des Temps et des Activités (GTA) spécialisé dans le secteur du BTP en France et en Europe. Notre mission est de fournir des solutions SaaS innovantes qui améliorent la productivité et la gestion des ressources de nos clients. Nous recherchons un Chef de Projet/Consultant Fonctionnel GTA pour piloter nos projets clés et assurer la satisfaction de nos clients. Vos missions Tu as pour mission principale de piloter des projets de mise en œuvre de solutions GTA, tout en assurant une fonction de conseil auprès de nos clients. Tu es le point de liaison principal entre les équipes techniques, les clients et les utilisateurs finaux, garantissant ainsi le succès du projet. Gestion de projet : Comité de pilotage : Planifier et animer les comités de pilotage pour suivre l'avancement des projets et prendre des décisions stratégiques. Comité projet : Organiser et animer les comités de projet pour assurer la coordination entre les différentes parties prenantes. Comité de suivi de la recette : Superviser les comités de suivi de la recette pour valider les livrables et les tests fonctionnels, et ainsi assurer la qualité de la solution et la satisfaction client. Mise à jour du planning : Collaborer avec le client pour mettre à jour et suivre le planning du projet. Mise à jour de la matrice des risques : Identifier, évaluer et suivre les risques du projet en collaboration avec le client. Piloter le plan de bascule : Assurer la transition et la mise en production du projet. Arbitrages et Go/No Go : Prendre des décisions critiques sur les étapes clés du projet et les points de bascule. Animer et coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires impliquées dans le projet. Proposition méthodologique : Être force de proposition sur la méthodologie projet (pilotage et conseil) et adapter les processus pour une application full SaaS en développement agile. Consultant fonctionnel : Ateliers fonctionnels : Organiser, cadrer et animer des ateliers fonctionnels pour définir les besoins du client, que ce soit sur des sujets nouveaux ou en s'appuyant sur des projets existants. Accompagnement des équipes de développement : Collaborer avec les équipes de développement pour garantir une compréhension claire des enjeux et des éléments à développer/paramétrer. Paramétrage de niveau 1 : Participer activement au paramétrage de la solution TRAXXEO. Phase de recette : Accompagner le client lors de la phase de recette, en le guidant et en le challengeant pour garantir la qualité des livrables. Formation des équipes projets : Participer à la formation des équipes projets et clients sur les solutions GTA Vos compétences Expérience en gestion de projet : en tant que chef de projet ou consultant dans le domaine de la GTA ou de la paie, idéalement dans le secteur du BTP. Compétences fonctionnelles : Solide expérience en animation d'ateliers fonctionnels, en accompagnement de clients et connaissance en paramétrage de solutions. Esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et force de proposition. Une expérience chez un éditeur de GTA serait un plus. Méthodologie : Bonne connaissance des méthodologies de projet, idéalement en agile, et capacité à proposer et adapter des méthodologies de projet. Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, capacité à animer des réunions et à interagir avec divers interlocuteurs. Analyse et résolution de problèmes : Capacité à identifier, anticiper analyser et résoudre les problèmes rapidement et efficacement. Gestion du risque Orientation client : Sens du service client, capacité à comprendre et anticiper les besoins des clients. Autonomie mais aussi esprit d'équipe, rigueur et organisation. Avantages Rejoindre une entreprise innovante et dynamique. Travailler sur des projets variés et stimulants, et pour des acteurs majeurs du BTP Évoluer dans un environnement de travail collaboratif et bienveillant. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.</p> <p>Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.</p> <p>You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security &amp; Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI &amp; Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.</p> <p>Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.</li> <li>Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.</li> <li>Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.</li> <li>Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.</li> <li>Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.</li> <li>Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.</li> <li>Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.</li> <li>Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.</li> <li>Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.</li> <li>Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.</li> <li>The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.</li> <li>Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.</li> <li>Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li>Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.</li> </ul> <p>If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a title: AI Engineer - H/F
description: L’IA, chez nous, ne s’arrête pas au POC. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne livres pas une démo qui tourne sur un portable : tu conçois, tu industrialises et tu déploies des solutions IA qui vivent en production chez des grands comptes. En tant qu’AI Engineer, tu es responsable de la conception technique, de la mise en production et de la fiabilité de ce qu’on construit. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu construis des architectures IA sur mesure. LLM, RAG, fine-tuning, agents : tu choisis les briques, tu assumes les arbitrages techniques et tu les expliques. Pas d’empilement d’outils à la mode, des choix justifiés par un cas d’usage qualifié. Tu emmènes tes modèles jusqu’en production. Déploiement, monitoring, latence, coûts, robustesse dans le temps. C’est là que le métier se joue vraiment, et c’est ce qu’on attend de toi du premier jour au dernier. Tu passes du prototype à l’échelle. POC, MVP, pipelines industriels : tu sais quand il faut aller vite et quand il faut consolider, en gardant l’enjeu business en ligne de mire. Tu travailles au contact direct du métier. Product Managers, équipes Data, MLOps, et surtout le client. Tu expliques ce que fait le modèle, ce qu’il ne fait pas, et pourquoi. Tu fais monter les autres. Acculturation IA des équipes internes et des équipes clientes, partage de ce que tu as appris en atelier, contribution à la practice Agents IA. Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant.e et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de référent.e technique, Lead IA ou Architecte Gen-AI. 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. Plus de 10% de notre chiffre d’affaires vient déjà de missions 100% IA : tu travailles sur des sujets réels, pas sur des sujets de plaquette. Une practice dédiée aux Agents IA, avec des pairs qui font le même métier que toi. Tu ne seras pas l’unique profil technique au milieu de consultants qui n’ont pas le vocabulaire. Un cadre qui récompense la progression, pas l’ancienneté : Campus de deux semaines à l’arrivée, buddy dédié, mentorat de proximité, revalorisations bi-annuelles. Des valeurs fortes : depuis 2016, Hubvisory grandit autour de l’ambition, l’expertise, la curiosité, la méritocratie et l’exigence bienveillante. Le package : 42.000-48.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire. 👉 Le profil que nous recherchons Tu as une vraie expérience de l’IA générative en conditions réelles : LLM, RAG, création d’agents. Tu as déjà mis un modèle en production et tu sais décrire ce qui s’est passé entre « ça marche en local » et « ça tourne chez le client ». Côté technique : Python, APIs, déploiement cloud et conteneurisation. Le ML classique est un atout, la GenAI est le socle. Anglais courant obligatoire. Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : la capacité à vulgariser face à un interlocuteur non technique, une curiosité entretenue (on te demandera ton dernier effet « waouh » en entretien) et de la débrouillardise sur des sujets sans mode d’emploi. Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? Étape 1 : Échange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle Étape 2 : Entretien technique GenAI avec un AI Engineer de la practice Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP Étape 4 : Échange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum ! Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog. description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet mené au sein du département Optique (rattaché à l’unité mixte de recherche Lab-STICC CNRS UMR 6285), qui vise à maintenir, faire évoluer et valoriser la plateforme technologique XTREM’IA dédiée aux réseaux optiques passifs de nouvelle génération et à la convergence fixe-mobile (5G/O-RAN), nous recrutons une ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement. Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle de Luiz ANET NETO (Maître de conférences du département Optique) vous assurerez le maintien en condition opérationnelle et l’évolution matérielle et logicielle de la plateforme vers le standard XGS-PON, développerez des activités de Machine Learning et d’apprentissage par renforcement profond pour l’optimisation autonome des réseaux, et participerez à l’industrialisation ainsi qu’à la valorisation des logiciels et des jeux de données ouverts. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Compétences requises en technologies et architectures d’accès optiques (G-PON, XGS-PON), en programmation Python (et idéalement C/C++), ainsi qu'en environnements de développement logiciel (Git, Docker, CI/CD, Linux). ✔️ Expérience attendue en développement d'algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique ou profond, en architectures SDN (modèles YANG, interfaces RESTCONF) ou en intégration avec des piles 5G/O-RAN. ✔️ Qualités recherchées : rigueur, méthode, pragmatisme, fort esprit d'initiative et curiosité scientifique pour l’expérimentation. Goût prononcé pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et excellentes qualités de communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais. 🎓 Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un master 2 (Bac + 5) en télécommunications, réseaux, informatique ou traitement du signal, ou d’un doctorat (Ph.D.) en réseaux optiques ou intelligence artificielle appliquée aux réseaux.     POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE : 👉 Environnement exceptionnel de travail : Intégrez le campus d'IMT Atlantique à Brest (Plouzané), au cœur d’un pôle d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche d’excellence en technologies de l’information. 👉 Écosystème d’innovation stimulant : Collaborez au sein du Lab-STICC (CNRS UMR 6285) et du laboratoire commun Lab’Optic (en partenariat stratégique avec Orange Innovation et l’Institut Foton), au contact direct de chercheurs, de doctorants et de partenaires industriels majeurs. 👉 Recherche à forte visibilité : Contribuez à des projets d'envergure nationale et européenne (tels que le PEPR 5G Photonique) et participez activement à la production de publications et de jeux de données ouverts pour la communauté scientifique internationale dans une démarche de science ouverte. LE PLUS : 🥗 Restauration collective sur place 🏃‍♀️ Offres de loisirs/sport 🚌 Prise en charge des transports en commun 🚴‍♂️ Forfait mobilité durable (pour le covoiturage ou les trajets en vélo) 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Complément familial 💶 Large gamme de prestations sociales 🖥️ Télétravail partiel possible 🌴 Nombreux congés    INDICATIONS DE REMUNERATION : 💰 Rémunération indicative : à partir de 33 748€ brut annuel, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public).    POUR TOUS RENSEIGNEMENTS : Sur le contenu du poste : Luiz ANET NETO – Maître de conférences : Sur les aspects administratifs/RH: Mélissandre MORVAN – Assistante recrutement   Date limite de candidature : 25/10/2026 Début du contrat : 01/01/2027 Entretien : au fil de l’eau   Mentions Légales  : Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 8 mois de droit public ou détachement sur contrat pour les fonctionnaires Localisation du poste : IMT Atlantique campus de Brest - 655 Av. du Technopôle, 29280 Plouzané À usage interne : Catégorie –métier du poste : II R Catégorie et métier des personnes pouvant postuler : II : D , E, F, G, H, I, R III : J1, J2, K, L, M Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuelles Toute candidature peut faire l’objet d’une enquête administrative Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Doctorant.e: Quantification des pesticides dans les dépôts atmosphériques : Origine et Variabilité  CDD 36 mois à IMT Nord Europe
description: Unité : CERI EE (IMT NE) et Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie l'Environnement et la Santé (ICPEES, UMR 7515 CNRS, Université de Strasbourg) Responsable hiérarchique : Nadine Locoge (IMT NE) Responsable fonctionnel : Dr. Aude Bourin (IMT NE), Prof. Alexandre Tomas (IMT NE), et Prof. Maurice Millet (Université de Strasbourg) Catégorie : Nature de l’emploi : Doctorat Lieu de travail : Strasbourg / Douai Contexte : Le doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d’Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d’IMT Nord Europe et l’UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA : ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l’Energie, l’Environnement et la Santé) dont l’objectif est de renseigner l’influence des pluies sur les dépôts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des données existantes dans l’air ambiant. L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille. IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital. Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ». Le CERI EE d’IMT Nord Europe développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques). Contexte :

Le doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d’Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d’IMT Nord Europe et l’UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA : ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l’Energie, l’Environnement et la Santé) dont l’objectif est de renseigner l’influence des pluies sur les dépôts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des données existantes dans l’air ambiant.

L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques).

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr et celui du CERI EE https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’ICPEES :

https://icpees.unistra.fr

Missions :

Le doctorant aura pour mission d’évaluer la dynamique des dépôts atmosphériques de pesticides à différentes échelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l’observatoire MERA (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera) et les AASQA (https://www.atmo-france.org/) sur le territoire national.   •            effectuer des essais techniques pour vérifier la conformité des appareils de collecte des dépôts atmosphériques (Douai)

  •            modification de méthodes existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS (retraits/ajouts de molécules),

  •            développement MSMS des nouvelles molécules,

  •            validation de la méthode (limites de détection et de quantification, répétabilité, reproductibilité,…)

  •            choix de la méthode de préparation des échantillons (LLE, SPE, SPME, …),

  •            évaluation des interférences et de l’effet de matrice par dopage avec des étalons deutérés et des molécules de pesticides non présentes dans les échantillons (screening de la présence/absence en amont)

  •            traitement des résultats obtenus d’analyses : prétraitement des données, intégration des chromatogrammes, identification des composés, quantification et validation des résultats avec contrôle qualité

description: Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM. Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet AMI CMA 3MRBAT qui porte sur l’évaluation environnementale de différents scénarios du cycle de vie des batteries lithium-ion, avec pour objectif de mieux comprendre les principaux « hot spot » des batteries.   Vos missions : Vous vous appuierez sur l’expertise des partenaires de 3MRBAT, et sur les données techniques des principaux projets industriels qui sont en débat Public au niveau de la France et sur la littérature scientifique existante. Un soin particulier sera apporté au niveau de l’impact sur les ressources en eau, l’ensemble des activités de cette filière nécessitant de grands volumes d’eau. Vous contribuerez au développement des enseignements d'IMT Mines Alès dans le cadre du Mastère Spécialisé PRINEC. Vous participerez à la conception et à la mise en place d'un module de formation interactif sur le cycle de vie des batteries, afin de mettre en évidence l’influence des différents scénarios d’approvisionnement, de fabrication, d’utilisation et de fin de vie sur les impacts environnementaux. Vous préparerez les supports pédagogiques et assurerez les enseignements associés. Vous participerez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux réalisés dans le cadre du projet. Vous serez encouragée à diffuser les résultats de vos recherches au travers de publications dans des revues scientifiques internationales, de communications lors de congrès nationaux et internationaux, ainsi que de présentations auprès des partenaires du projet. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Why is this role important for Pennylane? Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company. This step is foundational to delivering a comprehensive financial-services product for our clients, on a model that is robust, scalable, and supervision-ready. From day one, the ACPR will expect PFS to demonstrate clear security governance, effective oversight of critical dependencies, and credible evidence of operational resilience - with a strong security-by-design approach. How will you contribute to the project? You will own PFS’s security governance and overall security and resilience policy, under the direct supervision of the Chief Compliance and Risk Officer. Your contribution is to design a risk and control framework that is proportionate to PFS’s activity and regulatory expectations, and to ensure PFS can evidence "security by design" through auditable, inspection-ready artefacts. In practice, this includes: Policy alignment: ensure consistency between PFS and Pennylane SAS security policies, leveraging the group framework where appropriate while prioritising PFS’s regulatory obligations. Security by design: translate requirements into actionable standards and control expectations, embedded into product and engineering delivery. Operational resilience: shape incident-management and continuity expectations, ensure they are testable, and drive evidence of effective execution. Oversight of key stakeholders: establish effective oversight of Pennylane SAS and key providers, with clear expectations, monitoring and remediation follow-through. This is a role for a technically credible security leader with strategic judgement - with the technical depth to challenge architectures, controls and evidence, and the seniority to own governance and executive reporting. What will your day-to-day responsibilities be? Own PFS Information Security policy: define, maintain and continuously improve PFS security governance, standards and policy set. Manage the PFS risk and control framework: maintain the security risk taxonomy, control objectives, key risks/KRIs, escalation thresholds, and evidence expectations. Embed security-by-design into the Product/Tech development cycle: leverage Pennylane SAS policies and existing ways of working where applicable, ensuring PFS security requirements and regulatory obligations are reflected in the delivery lifecycle, change process and go/no-go decisions, without creating unnecessary process overhead. Ensure operational resilience / continuity / testing: define resilience requirements and ensure end-to-end testing and exercises produce usable evidence and tracked remediation. Manage outsourcing arrangements and audits: oversee security aspects of outsourcing arrangements (intragroup and third parties), ensure auditability and follow through on findings and remediation. Provide executive-level reporting: deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on information-security posture, incidents, resilience testing and remediation to PFS management and the Supervisory Board. KPIs / signals: Policy & standards effectiveness: evidence of adoption (e.g., security requirements consistently reflected in delivery artefacts for material initiatives) and reduction of recurring “same class” issues over time. Core security KRIs (within risk appetite): a small set of measurable KRIs with thresholds and owners (e.g., critical vulnerability exposure, privileged-access exceptions, key third-party risks), tracked and escalated when outside appetite. Resilience testing KPIs: tests/exercises executed vs plan; % of high-severity findings remediated within agreed timelines; retest completion for failed scenarios. Incident classification & remediation tracking: consistent classification, timely escalation, and tracked remediation to closure (including post-incident action closure rate). Audit follow-up tracking: audit findings/actions ageing, % overdue by severity, and executive visibility on the top overdue items. Threat & vulnerability landscape monitoring: regular review of the external threat/vulnerability landscape and its concrete impact on PFS priorities (what changes in controls, monitoring, or roadmap). Ramp-up / expectations during the probation period: Establish the initial PFS security governance baseline (policy set, decision rights, reporting cadence). Propose and align a first set of PFS security KRIs and risk appetite thresholds (with owners and escalation path). Produce a first resilience testing plan (what is tested, frequency, evidence expected) and agree success criteria. Put in place an incident classification approach and a remediation tracking routine that is audit-ready. Profile we are looking for Must-have Fintech and/or Banking experience Strong experience in information security, technology risk, cyber-risk or security assurance, with ownership of complex topics. Proven ability to design and run security governance and a risk/control framework with audit-ready evidence. Experience working with outsourced / third-party / group-shared technology services while retaining accountability.
